## What was done

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVParserAgentTest.java` — matching the existing convention in this project (JUnit 4.11, `org.junit.Test`, static `org.junit.Assert.*` imports, `@Test(expected=…)` for error cases, ASF license header, same package).

Coverage of the public API only (`parse(File/String/URL…)`, the `Reader` constructor, `getRecords`, `iterator`, `getHeaderMap`, `getRecordNumber`, `getCurrentLineNumber`, `isClosed`, `close`):

- **Factory methods & constructor**: happy-path parsing for `String`, `File`, `URL`, and `Reader`; null-arg rejection (`IllegalArgumentException`) for every parameter of every overload; inconsistent `CSVFormat` → `IllegalStateException`; non-existent file → `IOException`.
- **`getRecords()`**: empty input returns empty list (record number stays 0), missing trailing newline, sequential per-record numbers, resumption from the current stream position after partial iteration, `IOException` after `close()`, unterminated quote and invalid char after a closing quote both throw `IOException`.
- **Value handling**: quoted value containing the delimiter, `withNullString` → `null` value, empty lines skipped under `DEFAULT` but materialized as records under `RFC4180`.
- **Line/record numbers**: both start at 0; line number tracks consumed physical lines; record number advances during iteration; line number diverges from record number when a value spans multiple lines.
- **`getHeaderMap()`**: `null` when no header; explicit header (not consumed from input, column-ordered, name-based access); header auto-read from first record (which *is* consumed); `withSkipHeaderRecord`; returned map is an independent copy.
- **`iterator()` / `Iterable`**: for-each consumes all records, `hasNext()` is idempotent, `next()` past the end throws `NoSuchElementException`, `remove()` throws `UnsupportedOperationException`, and after `close()` `hasNext()` is false / `next()` throws.
- **`close()` / `isClosed()`**: state flips on close; `close()` is idempotent.
